d:
Bihar men janganna-2027 ka karyakram jari kar diya gaya hai. rajy men 25 janavri se 28 pharavri 2027 tak ghar-ghar jakar jansankhya ki ganna hogi. isse pahle 10 janavri se 24 janavri tak nagrikon ko sv-ganna yani Self Enumeration ka vikalp milega.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
